changelog: Initial proposed specification based on existing Wave A v1; no new market experiment or owner selection. Companion source/cost/variant bytes are bound.

hypothesis.economic_mechanism: HYPOTHETICAL: close-confirmed opening-range breach may reflect persistent directional demand after initial price discovery. This is a research mechanism, not observed Nifty evidence.
hypothesis.participant_constraint: HYPOTHETICAL: investors implementing larger decisions in smaller sequential orders may sustain direction; auction/opening adjustment and liquidity demand are alternative explanations. Specific participant evidence UNKNOWN.
hypothesis.event_signal: First 15 complete one-minute regular-session bars define max(high) and min(low). Starting at next bar, first close strictly above high emits +1; strictly below low emits -1. At most one signal/session; otherwise no signal. Remove events whose 30-minute diagnostic label crosses close.
hypothesis.decision_timestamp: Signal completed-bar close, no earlier than verified data availability. Historical bar label start/end and publication delay UNRESOLVED; stop before scoring if role unverified. Never simulate entry at signal close.
hypothesis.holding_horizon: 15 trading minutes primary index markout; 5 and 30 minutes descriptive only. No executable holding policy selected.
hypothesis.expected_sign: POSITIVE direction-aligned mean is the proposed claim; not established.
hypothesis.expected_size_range: UNKNOWN: no authorized estimate or cited Nifty size range exists; do not copy plan cost/return examples.
hypothesis.rationale_sources: Wave A Signal Spec S01 is the existing rule lead. S01/S13 explain matching/inventory information limits, not this alpha. Participant persistence mechanism is an explicit inference without direct Nifty confirmation.

instruments.research_universe: NIFTY 50 index signal only, ASSUMPTION_PENDING_OWNER_CONFIRMATION. C_INDEX is retained for desk design; no market series is permitted for collection or an eligible trial.
instruments.identity_requirements: Exact index identifier, source/product, dated calendar and source timestamp role. Later futures/options require venue/segment, expiry, strike/right, dated symbol/token mapping, lot/tick/master and settlement inputs; never map an index close to a derivative fill.
instruments.contract_selection: No traded contract selected. Index has no expiry/roll. Any future/options translation requires a separate frozen card with point-in-time deterministic contract/strike choice before outcomes.
instruments.expiry_roll_policy: No roll in index score. Derivative contract selection, expiry exclusions, roll executions and settlement rules UNRESOLVED; current master or continuous chart cannot substitute.
instruments.candidate_disposition: C_INDEX RETAIN_PENDING_RIGHTS_AND_QUALITY; C_FUT/C_OPT_CALL/C_OPT_PUT DEFER; C_SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE_ONLY. Full comparison in G1-INSTRUMENT-COMPARISON-2026-11-08.md.

measurement.primary_metric_definition: For each fully eligible regular session take mean of a*log(index_close_t+15/index_close_t) over this rule's signals, times 10000; zero for a complete no-signal session, never zero for missing data. Primary estimate equal-weight mean of session scores.
measurement.units: Basis points of index log-price markout; not INR P&L, futures notional return or option premium return.
measurement.observation_unit: Complete regular session; conditional per-signal estimates secondary. Intraday observations within sessions not independent.
measurement.benchmark_definition: Flat/no-signal session-score zero. It is a statistical signal comparator with no executable investment or cost inference.
measurement.secondary_diagnostics: Fixed 5/30-minute index markouts, conditional signal mean/median, hit rate with zero labels separate, tails, no-signal frequency, exclusions and time-of-day; descriptive, cannot rescue primary failure.

data.source_fields_frequency: Angel historical index OHLC one-minute source is a prior project lead only; current docs inaccessible S09. No collection or history entitlement. Need raw label/offset, OHLC, index identity, source version and file hash. No invented index volume.
data.timestamp_roles: Source label, verified bar interval/start/end, exchange/source publication if present, UTC local receive and monotonic time if captured. Historical receive availability UNKNOWN; do not backdate knowledge.
data.session_calendar: Dated official regular/special session and holiday calendar; exclude special sessions unless separate predeclared regime. CAS/pre-open/closing reference issues UNRESOLVED; S19 not accessible.
data.known_gaps: Prior report records 2026-10-30 15:14 to 15:28 jump and partial 2026-11-02 smoke exposure. No raw data acquired here, no repairs or causal inference. Full missing days, timestamp convention, revisions and history remain unknown.
data.minimum_usable_sample: Per score complete required regular session, first 15-minute range, decision and up to 30-minute labels. Research requires all nonempty chronological partitions and development-only precision/sample-floor review before labels: PENDING_G2_DATA. Missing sessions never treated as no-signal zero.
data.collection_storage_replay_derived_sharin: Collection UNRESOLVED; local storage/backups/retention UNRESOLVED; replay UNRESOLVED; derived outputs UNRESOLVED; sharing UNRESOLVED. Public source access and synthetic permission fixtures grant no market rights.

execution.signal_vs_pnl: Signal-only. No executable orders, fills or net P&L. Index candle markouts must not be multiplied by futures lot or priced as options.
execution.order_type: No order in this card. Later traded study: proposed bounded marketable IOC simulation only if dated API/exchange permissions support it; limit/price bound and actual route UNRESOLVED.
execution.latency_spread: No execution applied to signal score. Later study requires measured receive/decision/release delay, bid/ask side and separately frozen stale cutoff; all amounts UNKNOWN.
execution.fills_queue_partial_missed: No fill inference. Later L1 model must retain whole-lot partials, IOC remainders, missed/failed exits and intended quantity; no queue-position assertion from broker snapshots. Passive touch never fills by assumption.
execution.impact_adverse_selection: Later size/impact sensitivity and side-aligned post-fill mid markout at declared horizon required; amounts UNKNOWN. Do not double-charge adverse movement already in exit P&L.

economics.cost_formula: G1-COST/v1: itemized trade/expiry fees + crossing + incremental latency/slippage/impact + financing + allocated fixed/time + capital hurdle. Details G1-COST-WALL-V1.md. No net economics calculated for an index score.
economics.component_status: Cost attachment holds dated public rate references only; actual amounts blank. Brokerage/clearing/GST taxable basis/spread/slippage/latency/impact/settlement applicability UNKNOWN or PENDING_SOURCE_REVIEW. No unknown is zero.
economics.capital_margin_funding: PENDING_OWNER_INPUT: private capital, annual hurdle/funding and approved margin/feasibility. Margin/principal are not fees or guaranteed loss limits.
economics.fixed_time_cost: PENDING_OWNER_INPUT: private recurring cash, time hours/opportunity rate and allocation denominator. Keep annual fixed spend even with no fills; outside Git/chat.
economics.sensitivity_scenarios: K0 fees-only partial reference, K1 assumed marketable full fills, K2 partial/missed intended-quantity scoring, K3 joint stressed friction plus capital/fixed/time. Magnitudes UNKNOWN, separate later execution card required.

design.all_candidates_variants: Bound G1-VARIANTS/v1 records S01-S10 archetypes, three Wave A baselines, six primary confirmatory comparisons, six descriptive horizons, bootstrap sensitivity and four planned cost scenarios. No threshold/universe grid authorized.
design.prior_exposure: UNKNOWN total experiments/views; disclosed partial 2026-11-02 smoke and 2026-10-30 data-gap inspection. Independent preregistration UNVERIFIED. Require owner exposure audit and untouched periods.
design.development: PENDING_G2_DATA: proposed chronological 60% complete sessions; only development can assess precision/eligible sample before validation. Exact dates/seed/sample requirement reviewed before forward labels.
design.validation: PENDING_G2_DATA: chronological next 20%, exact dates frozen before labels; test unchanged rules, no tuning.
design.holdout: PENDING_G2_DATA: chronological final 20%; untouched until authorized one-shot protocol. Card facility has no access/unlock mechanism. No universe/parameter choice from holdout.
design.multiple_testing: Existing Wave A proposal: all three rules reported, two confirmatory partitions => six comparisons with two-sided 99.1667% stationary-bootstrap intervals; mean block 5, 10000 resamples. 2/10 sensitivity descriptive. No DSR/PBO/HAC formula changes or inference certification.
design.no_retuning: No thresholds tuned on validation/holdout. Revised rule, universe, metric, execution or decision criterion gets new version/family and new untouched period. Unknown history cannot be hidden by narrowing family.

decisions.falsification_rejection: Existing Wave A: positive-signal pass only if positive adjusted interval excludes zero in validation and holdout; reject positive claim if adjusted holdout interval entirely below zero. Zero-inclusive/disagreeing/unstable assumptions => INCONCLUSIVE. Failure to establish minimum precision => NOT_TESTABLE/INCONCLUSIVE. No economic pass from these scores.
decisions.missing_data_behavior: Exclude affected session/event per fixed required information; report missingness and exclusions, no forward fill. If rights, clock/session/identity/completeness unverified stop before outcomes; never omit failed fills in later execution research.
decisions.stop_conditions: G0 open; unreviewed rights/calendar/timestamp/master/cost or holdout exposure; undeclared changes; incomplete history; private budgets/reviews missing. Stop promotion and preserve evidence. No acquisition/connectivity authorized.
decisions.required_approvals: Owner confirms G0 scope/A1-A15, private A15 precommitment and attestation, learning comprehension, candidate choice; independent reviewer checks source/variant/exposure/data/cost/rejection/splits before freeze. All PENDING_OWNER_INPUT.
